title: Commander Handshake 001 — establish Qoder multi-agent control plane
body:
# CityNexus Commander Handshake 001

Hello Commander. This message comes from the ChatGPT project-planning / external-arbitration window.

The user has authorized us to begin a Qoder-only multi-agent workflow. Do not start broad coding yet. First establish ground truth and a safe control plane.

## Repositories
- Product repo: `Canshu-King/CityNexus`
- Coordination repo: `Canshu-King/CityNexus-Workspace`

External GitHub inspection currently sees:
- `CityNexus-Workspace` is empty at the remote.
- `CityNexus` has branches including:
  - `integration/qoder-truth-frontend-v6-apple-ab`
  - `integration/baseline`
  - `eac/v19.2.2-realphone-codegate`
  - `master`
- `integration/qoder-truth-frontend-v6-apple-ab` is 48 commits ahead of `master` and 0 behind.
- The repository contains the current backend/frontend/contracts/tests working tree, including truth-contract tests for mobility, physical identity, Live, replans, E2E provenance, and V19.x gates.

Do not assume the remote branch is newer than the local Qoder integration tree. Local disk/Git is authoritative for current development until you prove otherwise.

## Mission 001 — reconnaissance only

1. List all registered Qoder chat sessions.
2. For each relevant CityNexus session record:
   - session id
   - title
   - working directory
   - running / idle / needs-attention state
   - current task
   - whether it has uncommitted writes
3. Read the relevant active sessions, especially the current truth/convergence and frontend lines.
4. Inspect the authoritative local CityNexus Git state:
   - repo path
   - HEAD
   - branch
   - `git status --short`
   - local branches/worktrees
   - remotes
   - relationship to GitHub `integration/qoder-truth-frontend-v6-apple-ab`
5. Build a WRITE-SET / OWNERSHIP map for the currently active tasks. Flag any two sessions that may modify the same production files.
6. Identify frozen truth contracts that workers must not weaken:
   - mobility provenance / fact_quality propagation
   - HARD_FEASIBLE_QUALITIES
   - physical identity / compare_physical_venue()
   - SAME / AMBIGUOUS semantics
   - authoritative E2E acceptance policy
   - current pass-15/current-line truth behavior
7. Do not merge, cherry-pick, reset, rebase, delete work, or redesign UI in this mission.
8. Do not create more than one new worker yet.

## Required reply

Return a compact control-plane report with exactly these sections:

- CURRENT_AUTHORITY
- SESSION_MAP
- ACTIVE_WORK
- WRITE_SET_CONFLICTS
- FROZEN_CONTRACTS
- SAFE_PARALLEL_SPLIT
- RECOMMENDED_COMMANDER_TOPOLOGY
- HUMAN_ATTENTION_REQUIRED
- NEXT_3_COMMANDS

If you can write to the coordination repository safely, also create or update:
`CITYNEXUS_AGENT_CONTROL.md`

It should contain only current facts, ownership, active work, blockers, and last verified gates. No stale historical prose.

For this first handshake, do not modify CityNexus production code.

When finished, send the report back to the user-facing Qoder conversation so it can be relayed to ChatGPT for arbitration.
